title: 句子边界与标点
goal: 识别残句和独立句之间的错误连接；选择语法完整且标点正确的句子。

points.label: 识别残句和独立句之间的错误连接
选择语法完整且标点正确的句子

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点及教学材料规格

sources.title: C2 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 依据所给研究文件中的写作语言与连贯性要求安排教学，不陈述考试事实

body.p: 完整的陈述句要有主语和谓语，谓语要能表示时态。because、although 等从属连词引出的分句，即使有主语和谓语，在作文中也不能单独成句。

body.box: The opening ceremony started after the organizers checked all the lights in the hall.

body.p: The opening ceremony started 是主句，after 引出的从句依附于主句。检查句子边界时，成分、连接词和标点都要核对，只数动词不够。

cards.title: 从句残句与逗号误连
rows: 从句独立成句
because 从句要和主句连成一句，中间用逗号。
Because the floor was wet. The players waited outside. → Because the floor was wet, the players waited outside the gym until noon.
从句独立成句
although 从句也要和主句连成一句。
Although the screen was small. Everyone could read it. → Although the screen was small, everyone could read the instructions from their seats.
逗号误连
把逗号改成句号，分成两句，后句首字母大写。
The hall was full, the audience waited outside. → The hall was full. The audience waited outside until the next session began.
逗号误连
两句是因果关系时，在逗号后加 so。
The notice was unclear, several visitors asked for help. → The notice was unclear, so several visitors asked the receptionist for further information.

cards.title: 主语与谓语缺失
rows: 缺主语
陈述句要写出主语，说明谁做了这件事。
Arrived before the doors opened and waited near the entrance. → The assistants arrived before the doors opened and waited near the main entrance.
缺主语
被动句也要写出主语，说明被放置的是什么。
Was placed beside the entrance to guide visitors. → A large map was placed beside the entrance to guide visitors around the building.
缺谓语
地点短语不能作谓语，前面要补出 be，时态与上下文一致。
The spare chairs near the window during the meeting. → The spare chairs were near the window during the meeting on Tuesday afternoon.
缺谓语
-ing 形式前要补助动词，或改成限定动词。
The staff preparing the room for the afternoon exhibition. → The staff were preparing the room for the afternoon exhibition when the guests arrived.

cards.title: 边界修复与标点
rows: 句号
拆成独立句后，后句首字母大写。
The gate was locked. The delivery driver called the office for another entrance.
并列连词
and、but、so 连接两个完整分句，连词前加逗号。
The desk was small, but it held all the materials for the workshop.
从属连词
从句在前时，后面加逗号；主句前不再加 so 或 but。
Because the boxes were heavy, the volunteers carried them together into the storeroom.
英文标点
用英文句号 . 和英文逗号 ,，标点后空一格。
The doors opened, and the visitors entered the gallery in a single line.

body.box: Draft: The new timetable on the wall. Several students checked it, they found the correct classroom.

body.p: 首句只有名词短语和地点短语，缺少谓语。第二句逗号两边都能单独成句，要改用句号，或者加连词。

body.box: The new timetable was on the wall. Several students checked it and found the correct classroom.

body.p: 第二句两个动作的主语都是 Several students，可用 and 连接两个谓语。保留 they 时，写成 Several students checked it, and they found the correct classroom。

items.stem: What is missing from this intended statement? The club members beside the registration desk after lunch.
options: A subject for the whole statement
A finite verb for the statement
An object after the registration desk
A conjunction before the club members
items.why: The club members 已是主语，beside the registration desk 是地点短语，缺少谓语。

items.stem: What is the main boundary error? The doors opened, the visitors entered the exhibition hall together.
options: The first clause lacks a subject before opened.
The second clause lacks a verb after visitors.
A dependent clause stands alone as a sentence.
A comma alone joins independent clauses.
items.why: The doors opened 和 the visitors entered 都能单独成句，只用逗号不能连接，即第四项。

items.stem: Which revision makes a complete sentence? Because the ticket printer had stopped working.
options: Because the ticket printer had stopped working, staff wrote passes by hand.
Because the ticket printer had stopped working. Staff wrote passes by hand.
Because the ticket printer had stopped working, so staff wrote passes by hand.
Because the ticket printer had stopped working, writing passes by hand.
items.why: 第一项由原因从句加完整主句构成。第三项错在 Because 和 so 重复连接。

items.stem: Which revision supplies the missing subject? Was stored in a locked cabinet after the lesson.
options: Stored in a locked cabinet after the lesson.
The cabinet after the lesson was stored.
The equipment was stored in a locked cabinet after the lesson.
Was the equipment in a locked cabinet after the lesson.
items.why: 原句缺主语，第三项补出被存放的 The equipment。第四项是疑问语序，却用了句号。

groups.text: A student theater group could not find its entrance tickets on the afternoon of a performance. The staff printed a new batch before the doors opened. A spare printer was in the office, so the group did not need to borrow equipment from another department.

items.stem: Join the two facts as a cause and result.
items.tail: a new batch before the performance.
items.why: Because 从句后接主句，不能再加 so。

items.stem: Write the missing past-tense form of be: The spare printer ___ in the office yesterday.
items.why: The spare printer 是单数，yesterday 表示过去，填 was。

items.stem: What is wrong with the sentence boundary? Although the design was ready for review.
options: A dependent clause has been left without a main clause.
Two independent clauses have been joined by a comma.
The complete main clause has no final punctuation.
The clause contains two unnecessary subject pronouns.
items.why: Although 引出从句，句中没有主句，即第一项。

items.stem: What is the problem in The archive opened, several researchers entered the reading room?
options: The first clause has no finite verb.
A comma alone connects two independent clauses.
The second clause has no stated subject.
A subordinate conjunction has been used twice.
items.why: The archive opened 和 several researchers entered 各有主语和谓语，只用逗号不能连接。

items.stem: Which repair supplies a finite verb without changing the stated location? Draft: The notice beside the main staircase.
options: Beside the main staircase, the notice.
The notice standing beside the main staircase.
The notice is beside the main staircase.
The notice beside the main staircase and.
items.why: 第三项加 is 作谓语，句子完整，地点不变。第二项的 standing 单独不能作谓语。

items.stem: Which version correctly uses a full stop between independent sentences?
options: The cabinet was locked. the caretaker brought a key.
The cabinet was locked, The caretaker brought a key.
The cabinet was locked。 The caretaker brought a key.
The cabinet was locked. The caretaker brought a key.
items.why: 第四项用英文句号，后句首字母大写。第一项后句首字母没有大写。

items.stem: Form a complete sentence from the dependent clause and its main clause.
items.why: although 从句后加逗号，再接主句 the team completed。主句前不能再加 but。

items.stem: Complete the repair of a statement that lacks a finite verb.
items.why: were placed 构成完整被动谓语，不能用 placing 代替。

items.stem: Choose the error label: subject / verb / connector. In the intended statement Was repaired before the morning inspection, the missing element is the ___.
items.why: Was repaired 已有谓语，被修理的对象没有出现，缺主语。

items.stem: Choose the error label: subject / verb / connector. In the intended statement The assistants sorting the files after lunch, the missing finite element is the ___.
items.why: The assistants 是主语。sorting 前缺助动词，不能单独作谓语。
